label: SYNTHETIC placeholder gene annotations for the shipped demo fixtures. Invented for software testing; not biology and not clinical or manufacturing guidance.

EXH1.description: SYNTHETIC placeholder standing for an exhaustion-associated regulator in T cells. Used by examples/cart/. The symbol does not correspond to a real human gene.

perturbations.conditions: Applies when stimulation runs to about 48 h; the deficit is reported to close when stimulation is shortened.
perturbations.mechanism: SYNTHETIC: loss of EXH1 is described as making cells less tolerant of extended stimulation, so the standard activation window overshoots for this genotype.

suggested_protocol_levers.basis: SYNTHETIC: 24 h is reported to restore control-level output
SYNTHETIC: 15 ng/mL is reported alongside the shortened activation

perturbations.conditions: Indirect: transduction tracks how strongly the cells were activated, so a mismatched activation window lowers the transduced fraction as well.
perturbations.mechanism: SYNTHETIC: no direct effect on vector entry is described; the change is a knock-on of weaker activation.
perturbations.source: SYNTH-CART-001 paragraph p0006 (synthetic fixture source), read together with p0003

experiments_not_possible_in_machine.assay: Inhibitory-receptor surface panel over the expansion window (for example a 5-colour exhaustion panel)
experiments_not_possible_in_machine.why_not_feasible: More colours than the in-loop cytometer carries, and the staining protocol needs wash steps that break the closed single-use path.
experiments_not_possible_in_machine.what_it_would_resolve: Whether the knockout's shortfall is activation-driven exhaustion or simply weaker initial activation. The two imply opposite protocol changes.

experiments_not_possible_in_machine.assay: Transcriptional profiling at the end of activation
experiments_not_possible_in_machine.why_not_feasible: No sampling-to-sequencing path exists in the closed process; it is an offline, multi-day workflow.
experiments_not_possible_in_machine.what_it_would_resolve: Which pathway the knockout actually perturbs, which would let the literature search target a mechanism instead of a parameter.

GENEX.description: SYNTHETIC placeholder standing for a myeloid-commitment regulator. Used by examples/production/. The symbol does not correspond to a real human gene.

perturbations.conditions: Only when the M-CSF dose is raised; at the control dose the knockout underperforms.
perturbations.mechanism: SYNTHETIC: loss of GENEX is described as raising the M-CSF concentration needed for commitment.

suggested_protocol_levers.basis: SYNTHETIC: 80 ng/mL is reported to reach control-level output

experiments_not_possible_in_machine.assay: Colony-forming unit assay on the harvested progenitors
experiments_not_possible_in_machine.why_not_feasible: A semi-solid culture read manually over one to two weeks; it is outside the closed process entirely.
experiments_not_possible_in_machine.what_it_would_resolve: Whether the knockout changes progenitor potential or only the dose needed to commit it.
